portals.flavour: The forest exhales. The trees thin to wire. Silence arrives like a wall.
The roots descend. The soil becomes cold water. Something ancient stirs below.
The break room window opens onto something green. You climb through the glass.
The trees lean inward. A stair descends where no stair stood before.
The rope slackens. Green arrives. Noise.
The rope becomes a lanyard. The silence becomes a hum. Fluorescent.
The beads are cold. Very cold. The ground is gone.
The water drains upward. Roots. Leaves. Light.
The seabed cracks. Dust pours in. You are standing in a wasteland.
There is no sound here. There never was.
Stone closes overhead. The water becomes a wet street under an impossible city.
The fluorescents cut out. The lanyard becomes rope. The silence is total.
The break room window opens onto something green. You climb through.
The parcel dissolves. Salt water. Dark.
The wasteland softens. Green overtakes the road.
A courier beacon becomes a tactical marker. The horizon resolves into a breach map.
The dungeon opens. Stone becomes bark.
A forgotten stairwell goes down farther than the dungeon should allow.
The lights go out. The station disappears. Rope. Silence.
The platform descends. The train never surfaces.
The final carriage opens onto a platform beneath a city that should not exist.
The stars rearrange. You are on a train. It is very late.
The telescope points down instead of up. Below is ocean.
One star fractures into eleven horizons.
The gears stop. The vines turn to rope. Silence.
The machinery quiets. Beneath the roots, city lights flicker.
A forest track straightens into a lantern-lit frontier road.
A cellar door opens on green light and turning gears.
A station clock strikes thirteen. Rails appear in the dark.
The alley narrows into worked stone and torchlight.
The road enters a forest where the branches hum like machinery.
The lantern flame stretches into a horizon of old magic.
A campaign road emerges from the mist, lanterns marking the way.
A ruin stair descends into a city beneath the world.
The tactical grid dissolves into dust and a long road.
The extraction vehicle is waiting. This time, you are driving.
The chequered flag becomes a tactical boundary line.
The road leaves the circuit and enters a world with too many horizons.
One realm lifts into the stars.
A gate becomes asphalt. An engine turns over on the other side.
